summary: Verified end-to-end that the ACTIVE gateway (Cashfree TEST) is used for ALL pay-in flows and that payout requests do NOT simulate when the active payout gateway is unconfigured. 12/12 pytest tests pass. Confirmed: (1) settings snapshot — active_payin_gateway=cashfree, active_payout_gateway=cashfree, cashfree_mode=test, TEST pg keys present, payout keys intentionally empty. (2) POST /api/payments/order {purpose:'wallet',amount:100} → real Cashfree order (gateway=cashfree, mode=test, cf_mode=sandbox, env=sandbox, method=cashfree_sdk, payment_session_id=session_..., mock:False). (3) POST /api/memberships/order for paid plan (silver-saver ₹299) → real Cashfree order (gateway=cashfree, payment_session_id present, no 'mock' key). (4) POST /api/starter-kit/order → real Cashfree order (kit price 999>0, payment_session_id present). (5) POST /api/partner/registration/pay/create-order → real Cashfree order (order_id carries REGFEE-<uid> receipt because Cashfree uses merchant-supplied receipt as order_id, but payment_session_id from sandbox.cashfree.com proves it is a real order). (6) Seeded a subscription-enabled service, created a subscription, POST /api/subscriptions/{id}/pay/order → real Cashfree order. (7) All 4 removed mock endpoints return HTTP 404: /api/payments/mock, /api/memberships/mock, /api/starter-kit/mock, /api/subscriptions/{id}/pay/mock. (8) Payout — seeded a pending partner_withdrawal and called POST /api/admin/partner/withdrawals/{wid}/action {action:'approve'}: resulting withdrawal.payout is NOT simulated (no pout_sim_ prefix, simulated:False), carries gateway='cashfree', gateway_mode='test', env='sandbox', and api='POST https://sandbox.cashfree.com/payout/transfers'. Because Cashfree payout creds are missing the resolver marks the config as incomplete and payout returns status='failed' with a clear error 'Cashfree TEST MODE (payout) is not fully configured.' — matching the spec (failed + clear error OR processing + intent). (9) Merchant withdrawal approval also routes via payout_service and produces the same non-simulated payout object with gateway=cashfree.
critical_code_review_comments: gateway_resolver.resolve(): the ACTIVE gateway is now forced-enabled for routing (enabled = _enabled_flag OR is_active) — this correctly removes the dev-bypass surface (a saved-but-untoggled active gateway can no longer silently fall to mock).

payment_service.create_order() now RAISES GatewayConfigError (never returns mock) and every touchpoint (payment_controller, membership_service, starter_kit_service, subscription_controller, partner_reg_service) maps this to HTTP 409 with a clear message — good, single source of truth.

payout_service.create_payout(): when the active payout gateway is incomplete/unconfigured, it returns {status:'failed', simulated:False, gateway, gateway_mode, env, api:<exact endpoint>} — never a pout_sim_ record. On real API failure it records status:'processing', intent:True with the same snap fields. Verified.

Cashfree hosted-checkout order_id = merchant receipt (REGFEE-<uid8> / KIT-<uid> / WALLET-<uid>) — that is by design, not a mock. payment_session_id from sandbox.cashfree.com is the correct real-order proof; any downstream test that inspected the 'REGFEE-' prefix as a mock indicator must be updated.
Removed mock endpoints all return 404 (verified) — no leftover routes.
test_credentials: Admin +919000000000, Partner +919000000003, Merchant +919000000002 — all OTP 123456. New customer registered with a random +9199xxxxxxxx phone + OTP 123456.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted a subscription-enabled service (id=TEST_sub_maid_svc), a partner_withdrawal (TEST_wd_*) and a merchant_withdrawal (TEST_mwd_*); all cleaned up after the run. Added a test address to the ephemeral test customer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cashfree TEST payin keys are in DB settings.integrations (cashfree_test_pg_app_id/secret). Cashfree TEST payout keys are intentionally NOT set — do NOT add them. To test payout paths against a real Cashfree sandbox response, add cashfree_test_payout_client_id/secret and expect intent (processing + intent:true) or a real payout_id depending on Cashfree sandbox availability. All /mock endpoints are removed — do NOT expect them to work. When creating regression tests remember Cashfree order_id equals the merchant receipt (WALLET-/KIT-/REGFEE-/<code>) — always assert payment_session_id + gateway=='cashfree' rather than the order_id shape.
rca of the issue: N/A — all target behaviours verified. Historical bugs (dev-mode placeholder + simulated payouts) are fixed by (a) forcing the ACTIVE gateway to be treated as enabled inside gateway_resolver.resolve so a saved-but-untoggled gateway cannot cause a silent bypass, (b) payment_service.create_order raising GatewayConfigError → 409 instead of returning mock, (c) payout_service.create_payout removing simulate-when-unconfigured and always attaching gateway/gateway_mode/env/api snap fields.
